title: Sitting at his side Stephen solved out the problem.
html_source:
Solving problems is what Stephen lives for.

Although Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man isn’t a prequel to Ulysses, Joyce was starting Ulysses as he was finishing off Portrait with only the relatively small Giacomo Joyce in between. In Portrait, Stephen is a gifted pupil and struggles as much with dealing with his talents as he does with the politics and religion of Ireland.
